resources.string: Progress while photos are sent to your PC
On the PC, press \"Pair phone\". Scan the QR code with the camera app, or type the address and the 6-digit code here.
Privacy: this app talks only to your paired PC on your local network. No analytics, no crash reports, no cloud. Photos on the phone are only read, never changed or deleted.
The PC does not accept this phone any more. Pair again.
Photos: only SELECTED photos. Only the photos you selected are synced and shown. Tap \"Grant access\" and choose \"Allow all\" to sync everything.
Photos: no access. The app needs to read your photos to send them to your PC for rating.
Photo locations: not allowed. Without \"media location\" access Android removes GPS data from the photos, so place filters (country, city) will not work.
Notifications: not allowed. Sync progress is not shown.

Rated Gallery sends your photos to your own PC on your local network, where they are rated. The PC sends back only the ratings.

• Photos: needed to read and send them. Photos are never changed or deleted.
• Media location: needed to keep the GPS position in the photos, for place filters.
• Notifications: to show sync progress.
